text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim: \"I am fully against the development of the driverless cars\"","quality":"explicit stance","description":"The essay states its position immediately and leaves no doubt about what it is arguing."},{"evidence":"multiple why-questions and cause-effect points about safety, freezes, and lane changes","quality":"reasoning depth","description":"The essay gives several connected reasons for its position rather than relying on one complaint."},{"evidence":"mentions potholes, stop signs, a child crossing, and technology freezing","quality":"specific support","description":"The essay uses concrete examples to show how driverless cars could fail in real driving situations."},{"evidence":"repeated focus on the driver staying alert and being in control","quality":"counterargument awareness","description":"The essay addresses the main tradeoff in the article by explaining why human control still matters for safety."},{"evidence":"includes opening claim, supporting paragraphs, and a concluding question","quality":"essay organization","description":"The essay has a clearer overall structure that helps the argument unfold from introduction to conclusion."}]}
